job: Put one setting on a row: what it is on the left, its control on the right.
purpose: The unit of a settings page. Title and a one-line description on the left, a control (switch, select, button) on the right. Rows separate with hairlines, never boxes. On a phone the control drops below the text. data-tone="danger" marks destructive rows.
useWhen: A settings page lists preferences, each with a switch, select or button.
A danger zone lists delete or revoke actions with their consequence.

avoidWhen.when: Rows are label and value pairs to read, not change.
A complete form with validation and a submit.
Rows are items in a list with a trailing action.
Rows are options of one choice.

variants.useWhen: A destructive row: delete the account, revoke every key.
The control aligns with the top of a long description.
The control aligns to the bottom of the row.
The control needs room, such as a text field or a segmented control.
